title: Ranger armor
wikitext: [[File:"Ranger Female Tower" concept art.jpg|225px|thumb|Concept art by [[Jason Juan]].]] {{TOCright}} A full set of [[Ranger]] armor consists of a mask, vest, gloves, leggings and boots. == Armor bonuses == [[Basic armor|Basic]] ranger armor provides up to a maximum of 70 [[Armor rating|armor]], 5 extra [[energy]], 1 extra [[energy recovery]] and 30 extra armor against elemental damage.
